ideas.name: Hedger Position Reversal
ideas.claim: Commodity futures heavily purchased by hedgers subsequently outperformed those heavily sold by hedgers. The sample included gold, silver, platinum and palladium; the reported portfolio result covers commodities collectively, not metals alone.
ideas.quote: And commodities which are purchased by hedgers subsequently outperform those that are sold by them.
ideas.mechanism: Short-term price reversal associated with hedgers providing liquidity to speculators.

rules.market: 26 US commodity futures, including gold, silver, platinum and palladium
rules.timeframe: Weekly position changes; 20 trading days following ranking
rules.entry: Rank futures by the prior week's change in hedgers' net long positions; buy the top half and sell the bottom half.
rules.exit: Measure returns over 20 trading days following the Tuesday ranking.

ideas.claimed_result: The top-half minus bottom-half portfolio averaged 43 basis points in excess return over 20 days. The paper says the CFTC position report is published on Friday, after the Tuesday ranking; part of the measured return therefore precedes public release.
